article_notes: B. gibsoni (smear, PCR-confirmed), 45 dogs at university veterinary hospitals (UVH Kokkalai, TVCC Mannuthy). Tables 2 and 3 compare infected dogs with healthy controls only. The discussion says biochemical alterations were mostly seen in complicated cases with two or more organs involved, but gives no per-group values or test. Nothing extracted.
